description: arXiv:2507.14171v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Importance-based structured pruning overwhelmingly relies on filter magnitude. This proxy is fundamentally flawed: due to scale invariance, functionally identical filters can receive arbitrarily different importance scores under rescaling. We propose IPPRO (Importance-based Pruning with PROjective Offset), a scale-invariant pruning frame...
